basis: Tier-1 per-asset ceilings, each set AT the value measured from the shipped .glb on 2026-11-08 (H4). A ratchet: raise a line only with the new measurement and the reason recorded in 00-start-here/MEASUREMENTS.md, section 'H4 asset budgets'.
scenes_basis: Per-level scene ratchet (OQ-040): peak renderer.info over the harness counters trace, set AT the measured value. Asserted by the harness `counters` stage. Raise a line only with the new measurement and the reason recorded in 00-start-here/MEASUREMENTS.md, section 'Scene budgets'. The Tier-1 ceilings (300 calls, 500k triangles) still apply on top.
classes_basis: D-020 (Tim): a hero asset is an externally authored or generated model with its own painted texture. These are CEILINGS for the class, ruled, not measured: about 30k triangles and a 1024 px texture per asset. One texture, one material, one draw call are the kit's own rule, kept (PROVISIONAL, OQ-070). Every hero asset still has its own line in assets, set AT its measured value, and that line may not pass these. There is no bytes ceiling: none has been measured yet.
backdrop_basis: D-020 painted backdrop textures (assets/backdrop/*.png, made from the seed by tools/art/backdrop-textures.mjs), each set AT its measured longest side and file size. Checked by tools/assets/paint-budget.mjs inside npm run assets:budget, which also requires each PNG to be exactly what the script gives. Raise a line only with the new measurement and the reason recorded in 00-start-here/MEASUREMENTS.md, section 'D-020 painted backdrop'.
cards_basis: D-021 painted cards (assets/backdrop/cards/*.png, made from ART-GEN's paintings in assets/backdrop/gen by tools/art/backdrop-cards.mjs: resized, nothing lighter than paper, nothing more coloured than the ramp, colour bled under the cut). Each set AT its measured longest side and file size. Checked by tools/assets/paint-budget.mjs inside npm run assets:budget, which also requires each card to be exactly what the script gives. Raise a line only with the new measurement and the reason recorded in 00-start-here/MEASUREMENTS.md, section 'D-021 painted cards'.
characters_basis: D-020 rigged characters (assets/char/*.glb, imported from assets/hero by npm run assets:build: unlit, base colour only, chroma cap, 1024 px KTX2, skin and clips as delivered). Each set AT its measured value and checked by tools/assets/paint-budget.mjs inside npm run assets:budget; the clip list must match exactly. A character is held to the hero class ceilings as well. Record a raise in 00-start-here/MEASUREMENTS.md, section 'D-020 hero assets'.
ui_basis: D-022 title and how-to-play paintings (assets/ui/, made from Tim's two paintings in assets/ui/src by tools/art/ui-art.mjs). Byte ceilings. title.webp and title.jpg are the brief's own limit ("at most about 350 KB"); the rest are each file's measured size. Checked by tools/assets/shell-budget.mjs. MEASUREMENTS.md "D-022 title screen".
audio_basis: D-022 sound (assets/audio/*.mp3, cut from fal takes by tools/gen/build-audio.mjs; assets/audio/MANIFEST.md lists each file, its take and its cost). Byte ceilings, the brief's own: the music loop "at most about 1.5 MB", each effect "at most about 50 KB". Checked by tools/assets/shell-budget.mjs. MEASUREMENTS.md "D-022 sound".
